title.narrative: UNICEF amplified the voices of Ethiopia's children globally, spotlighting humanitarian and development crises through strategic multimedia and high-level missions, driving international attention and resource mobilization.  UNICEF mobilized US$178mil, which is less compared to the same period last year, which was US$280 million. However, UNICEF was able to advocate for the rights of children during bilateral meetings with UN agencies, donors, and other embassies in Ethiopia.
